# JSSpeccy 3.2

The byte-identical WebAssembly core, Spectrum 48K ROM and 48K tape autoloader in
`assets/spectrum-data.js` come from the [JSSpeccy 3.2 release](https://github.com/gasman/jsspeccy3/releases/tag/v3.2).
The bundled source archive and COPYING cover JSSpeccy. The local tape reader
wraps its upstream `runtime/tape.js` for loading as a classic browser script.

The separate Mad Mix Game tape data is the ZX Spectrum side of the 1988 Topo Soft
Spectrum + Amstrad release from [World of Spectrum Classic](https://worldofspectrum.net/item/0002965/).
Its SHA-256 is `d87fe149e7fc28ce49742281cd1e836bd50fe7ec2980b9cab32e9cf212116f94`.
